sentences.text:
This is a repeat (fourth) application u/s. 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant who is in custody since 5.11.2020 in connection with Crime No. 488/2020 registered at Police Station Sardarpur,
District Dhar for the offences u/s. 302, 201, 420, 120-B, 467 and 468 of the IPC.

The first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 8.6.2021; second application was dismissed considering the statement of P.W.1 vide order dated 22.7.2022; and the third application was dismissed vide order dated 13.3.2023.

Now within a period of five months, this repeat (fourth)
application has been filed after examination of one more witness.
The applicant is filing the application after examination of every witness without there being any change in the circumstances.
It is a case of murder as well as forgery, cheating, etc.
No case for grant of bail is made out.
Accordingly, this repeat M.Cr.C. is dismissed.
